function.name: create_dispatch_request
function.description: Create an active new emergency dispatch request with available resources.

incident_location.description: The location of the incident in the street address format.

resource_ids.description: List of unique identifiers for the dispatch resources to be dispatched.

incident_type.description: The primary type of the incident.

incident_description.description: A brief description of the incident.

function.name: redirect_dispatch_resources
function.description: Redirect specific dispatch resources to an existing incident or a new location. If a location is provided, a new incident will be created and the dispatch resources will be redirected to the new incident.

resource_ids.description: List of unique identifiers for the dispatch resources to be redirected.

target_type.description: The type of the target location.

incident_id_or_new_location.description: If 'target_type' is 'Incident', provide the 'incident_id' of the incident to which the dispatch resources should be redirected. If 'target_type' is 'Location', provide the 'new_location' (street address format) to which the dispatch resources should be redirected.

function.name: EstimateDispatchTime
function.description: Estimate the dispatch time for a specific dispatch resource to reach a specified location.

resource_id.description: The unique identifier of the dispatch resource.

destination_location.description: The destination location for the dispatch resource, in the street address format.

function.name: find_nearby_resources
function.description: Find nearby dispatch resources based on a specified location and resource type.

location.description: The location to find nearby dispatch resources, in the street address format.

resource_type.description: The type of the dispatch resources to find. One of: 'Fire', 'Medical', 'Police'. If not provided, all types of dispatch resources will be considered.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return.

function.name: get_incident_data
function.description: Retrieve incident data for a specified incident.

incident_id.description: The unique identifier of the incident to retrieve data for.

function.name: get_resource_data
function.description: Retrieve data for a specified dispatch resource.

resource_id.description: The unique identifier of the dispatch resource to retrieve data for.

function.name: edit_incident
function.description: Edit the data for a specified incident. This function should be used to assign new resources to an incident unless they have already been notified; it will NOT notify them of the assignment.

incident_id.description: The unique identifier of the incident to edit.

incident_type.description: If provided, the new type of the incident.

incident_severity.description: If provided, the new severity of the incident.

incident_description.description: If provided, the new description of the incident.

incident_status.description: If provided, the new status of the incident.

resource_ids.description: If provided, the new list of unique identifiers for the dispatch resources assigned to this incident.

function.name: search_incidents
function.description: Search for incidents based on a specified location and incident type.

location.description: The location to search for incidents, in the street address format.

incident_type.description: The type of the incidents to search for, one of ['Fire', 'Medical', 'Police']. If not provided, all types of incidents will be considered.

severity.description: The severity of the incidents to search for, one of ['Low', 'Medium', 'High']. If not provided, all severities of incidents will be considered.

incident_status.description: If provided, the new status of the incident, one of ['Active', 'Closed'].

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return.
